dedupe_keys.name: esa navigation support office gnss slr and ionosphere products

description: The ESA Navigation Support Office publishes precise GNSS orbit and clock products, Earth rotation parameters, ionospheric maps and satellite laser ranging, DORIS and mission orbit products every day. The office, part of ESA operations at ESOC in Darmstadt, is ESA's centre of expertise for precise navigation, supports Galileo and EGNOS and represents ESA in the geodetic community as an analysis centre, deriving products independently from its own worldwide network of GNSS receivers. The public archive holds directories for GNSS products, ionosphere, SLR and DORIS products, Earth orientation, CPF laser predictions and orbits for CryoSat-2, Swarm and GOCE, updated daily. Coverage is global. Format and access: an open directory archive of product files. Licence: not stated on the pages read; free. Caveats: files follow geodetic exchange formats that need specialist software, and the office's products are one input to the combined IGS solutions. Ionospheric maps and precise orbits support space weather exposure studies for GNSS positioning and timing users. Related catalogue records are the IGS GNSS products and the CAS-TECRecon30 global ionospheric maps.
